ABOUT THE GYM

Built for a serious fitness journey, run by people who show up for you.

The Biggest Ladies & Gents Gym sits in the heart of MBD, Ruwi — one of the largest training facilities in Muscat, with two full floors and scheduled ladies' time, men's time, and combined sessions to fit everyone's routine.

Reviewers consistently point to the same things: a genuinely state-of-the-art equipment line-up, a clean and well-kept floor, and a coaching staff that's professional without being unapproachable.

Whether you're chasing a physique goal with a personal trainer or just want a reliable place to put in the work, the gym is built to make that easy — daily, from early morning to late evening.

FAQ

Questions? We have answers.

Find quick answers to common questions about membership, classes, pricing, and facilities.

What's included in membership?

+

All memberships include unlimited access to both training floors, all equipment, group classes (Zumba, Aerobics, Free Training), personalized diet planning, and coaching support. Student rates apply with valid student ID.

Can I try before committing?

+

Yes! We offer a one-day pass for 1 OMR so you can experience the gym, meet the trainers, and see if it's the right fit. Just stop by or call to book your visit.

Are the ladies' and gents' floors completely separate?

+

We have two full floors with scheduled ladies' time, men's time, and combined sessions. This gives everyone full facility access at times that work for them — it's about flexibility and comfort, not permanent separation.

Do I need to be a certain age?

+

Members must be at least 8 years old. We also have a kids' play area for younger family members while parents train, with supervision available.

What if I need to cancel my membership?

+

You can cancel anytime. We ask for 7 days' notice so we can process it smoothly. See our Terms of Service for full details on cancellation and refunds.

Do you offer personal training packages?

+

Yes. Personal training is included in all memberships for initial assessment and form checks. Premium one-on-one coaching packages are available — contact us for pricing and availability.

What are your hours?

+

We're open daily 5:00am–12:00pm and 1:00pm–1:00am. Ladies' time is 9:00am–12:00pm, and on Fridays we're open 5:00pm–9:00pm. Whether you're an early riser or a night owl, we've got you covered.

TERMS OF SERVICE

Legal terms & policies.

Please read our full terms before joining. Questions? Contact us anytime.

1. Membership Agreement

By purchasing a membership, you agree to these terms and gym policies. Membership is personal and non-transferable.

2. Payment Terms

  • Student rates: 12 OMR (1 month), 25 OMR (3 months)
  • Regular rates: 15 OMR (1 month), 30 OMR (3 months), 45 OMR (6 months), 75 OMR (1 year)
  • Payment is due upfront. Accepted methods: cash, card, bank transfer
  • Prices subject to change with 30 days' notice

3. Cancellation & Refunds

Cancellations require 7 days' written notice. Refunds are issued within 14 business days. Early cancellation fees may apply — contact staff for details. No refunds for unused class sessions.

4. Health & Safety

  • You confirm you are in good health and fit to exercise
  • We are not responsible for injuries sustained during training
  • Use all equipment safely and follow trainer instructions
  • Report hazards immediately to staff

Important: Consult a doctor before starting any fitness program, especially if you have existing health conditions.

5. Code of Conduct

  • Treat all members and staff with respect
  • Harassment, discrimination, or abuse will result in immediate suspension
  • Keep the gym clean — return equipment to its place
  • No photography or video recording without permission
  • No outside food or beverages (water stations available)

6. Liability Waiver

Members use all gym facilities, equipment, and classes at their own risk. The Biggest Fitness Gym is not liable for injuries, lost belongings, or damage to personal property. Use provided lockers at your own discretion.

7. Privacy & Data

We collect only essential membership information (name, contact, age, health notes). This information is kept confidential and never shared with third parties without your consent. See our privacy policy for details.

8. Class & Schedule Changes

We may modify class schedules, times, or instructors with 48 hours' notice. Schedule changes are posted at the gym and on our website.

9. Dispute Resolution

Any disputes should be reported to gym management first. We commit to resolving issues within 14 days. If unresolved, disputes may be escalated to arbitration.

10. Changes to These Terms

We reserve the right to update these terms anytime. Changes are effective immediately. Continued use of the gym after changes means you accept the new terms.

Last updated: September 2026. For questions or clarifications, contact us at 79 1010 73 or 79 2565 85.
